description: This file contains implementation of the MutationRemover class methods for removing list and tensor mutations in a Torch JIT graph, including handling of special mapped operations, alias analysis, and mutation patterns.

classes.name: MutationRemover
classes.description: Class responsible for removing mutation operations from a Torch JIT graph, including list and tensor mutations, with support for alias analysis and special operation handling.

methods.name: removeListMutation
methods.description: Removes list mutation operations from the graph.

methods.name: removeTensorMutation
methods.description: Removes tensor mutation operations from the graph.

methods.name: hasSideEffectOrAlias
methods.description: Checks if a value has side effects or may alias other values.

methods.name: createSpecialMappedOp
methods.description: Creates specialized mapped operations for certain tensor mutations.

methods.name: removableSetItem
methods.description: Checks if a node is a removable set item operation.

methods.name: listMutationFollowingListConstruct
methods.description: Checks if a node is a list mutation following a list construction.

methods.name: tryMakeCreationAndMutationAtomic
methods.description: Attempts to make tensor creation and mutation atomic.

methods.name: tryMakeUnaliasedIfOutputAndMutationAtomic
methods.description: Attempts to make an if-else output and mutation atomic if conditions are met.

methods.name: RemoveListMutation
methods.description: Function to initiate list mutation removal on a graph.

methods.name: RemoveTensorMutation
methods.description: Function to initiate tensor mutation removal on a graph with optional filter.

methods.name: InplaceToFunctionalActivation
methods.description: Replaces inplace activation functions with their functional equivalents in the graph.
